name: cui-language
description: Syntax highlighting and diagnostics for .cui declarative UI DSL files

cui.toolPath.description: Absolute path to the native CUI checker binary. If empty, the extension searches the workspace for tools/cui-rs/target/release/cui automatically.

cui.registryPath.description: Path to registry.json produced by 'cui scan'. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root. Leave empty to skip semantic validation.
